authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6663 dvāra gives regional dār door. Danuwar der is compared with this contracted door family, with fronting of the vowel retained rather than silently treating it as an exact match. Exact survey form der is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13561 sūtra gives Nepali sut thread and MIA sutta. Danuwar śutta fits the thread family; sibilant and gemination are retained in the record. Exact survey form śutːa is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3329 kurkura/kukkura explicitly means dog and gives Nepali kukur and neighboring kukar/kukur forms. The survey kukara/kukuru/kurkur shapes select this k-medial family, not kuttira with medial t. Exact survey form kurkur is preserved.
